method: Unique normalized Thumb instruction windows followed by call-target, literal-pool, register, and stack review. RAM entries use matched PC-relative loads, not address deltas. Two gesture sites require semantic review because the stock dispatcher added gating and expanded branches. Extended for g2flash d968c2c (BLE 2M/fast-connection byte patches, head-up gate, idle-input gate, sensor-hub compass diagnostics, R1 battery cache): the same window matcher plus side-by-side disassembly of every new site and callee.

0x553d39.derivation: 2.2.10.18 FW_CODEC_CTRL: thread.audio codec-control message poster (2.2.10.10 0x5565e0, Thumb +1). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly: production_codec_mic_func_init 0x5ab8ca does `movs r0,#1; bl 0x5565e0` and service_audio_manager acquire 0x56ac64 calls the same target (param 1 = DMIC open + I2S on + i2s init + 2 s codec check timer; 0 = timer stop + I2S deinit + output off; 2 = GX8002 reboot). 2.2.9.22 equivalent 0x553d38 located by the same call from the 2.2.9.22 production init. ABI (uint32 param) inferred from both stock callers; gated behind CONFIGURE flag bit2.

0x20077470.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key; RAM is not rebased). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of thread.audio/service_audio_manager: codec-on flag (u8): set 1 by the codec-control on-path 0x556404, 0 by the off-path; the one-shot codec audio check 0x5564d2 runs only while set. 2.2.10.18 clears it from the tap once frames flow (MIC_FLAG_MGR_CTRL).

0x20076e48.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key; RAM is not rebased). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of thread.audio/service_audio_manager: fresh DMA frame count (u32) incremented by the I2S DMA handler 0x55626a for frames dequeued within 41 ms; read by the codec audio check (needs >= 20 per 2 s window). Reported in the 2.2.10.18 status mirror.

0x200773d7.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key; RAM is not rebased). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of thread.audio/service_audio_manager: gx8002b I2S init state (u8, 'gx8002b i2s already init' guard in 0x595a58). Reported in the status mirror.

0x200773d6.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key; RAM is not rebased). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of thread.audio/service_audio_manager: codec power state (u8, 'codec is not power on' guard). Reported in the status mirror.

0x20077451.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key; RAM is not rebased). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of thread.audio/service_audio_manager: service.audio.manager master/slave boot-sync state (u8, set 1 on the RIGHT after msg 2). Reported in the status mirror.

0x200763b8.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key; RAM is not rebased). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of thread.audio/service_audio_manager: service.audio.manager app-slot table (u8[8], slots 1..6 used by stock apps, LEFT only): release powers the codec down when every slot is 0. 2.2.10.18 holds slot 7 while armed on the LEFT.

0x200765b8.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of the BLE connection-parameter path: slave (phone-link) connection-context pointer; +0x18 granted interval (1.25 ms), +0x1a latency, +0x1c supervision timeout (10 ms), +0x1e profile mode (0xa3 fast/0xa4 slow), written by the update-event handler 0x47cc08 and read by _connectParamReq_impl 0x47c0e8. Reported read-only in the 2.2.10.19 'ML' link record.

0x200773a5.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of the BLE connection-parameter path: fast-mode-in-effect flag, written by the update-event handler 0x47cc08 (set with the request timestamp 0x200765bc when the central grants the fast profile, cleared when it leaves it) and tested first by APP_ConnectParamESSSetFastMode 0x47d478. 2.2.10.19-.23 mislabelled it 'central connected' (it read 0 while connected on the default profile). Reported read-only in the 'ML' link record byte 3.

0x47c18d.derivation: 2.2.10.24 FW_CONN_FAST: connection-parameter fast-profile setter (2.2.10.10 0x47d428, Thumb +1; 2.2.9.22 0x47c18c). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of the protobuf device-config handler ('[pb.devc]pConnParams->setSpeed = eConnParamState_%s', 0x4d3eba new / 0x4d18fa old): setSpeed FAST does `movs r0,#0; bl` to this function, SLOW to 0x47d598/0x47c2fc. Body: if 0x200773a2 (slow-forced) set, marks 0x20004d80 slow; records requested mode 0xa3 via 0x47b922; stops the request timer (callback 0x47c710); if the argument is nonzero arms a 60 s auto-slow; then starts the request timer at 0 ms. 0x47c710 posts event 0xb9 to the BLE task, whose handler 0x47d6b4 calls _connectParamReq_impl 0x47c0e8 -> DmConnUpdate with the fast table. Ten stock callers (OTA, image transfer, pb) use the same (uint32 auto_slow) ABI. Called with 0 from mic_session_start and on RENEW while the granted profile byte is not 0xa3.

0x20004d7f.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of the BLE connection-parameter path: last mode handed to _connectParamReq_impl 0x47c0e8 (stored at its exit 0x47c6e8 and on the rate-limited deferral 0x47c402). 0x200765c4.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of the BLE connection-parameter path: request counter (u32) incremented by the request setter 0x47b922 on every fast/slow request. Reported read-only in the 2.2.10.26 'ML' link record.

0x553d5b.derivation: 2.2.10.28 FW_CODEC_PREP: codec-prep message poster the stock service_audio_manager acquire posts immediately before ctrl(1) (2.2.10.10 0x556602, Thumb +1; 2.2.9.22 0x553d5a, adjacent to ctrl 0x553d38/0x5565e0, offset +0x22). Identified 2026-09-14 by disassembly of acquire 0x56ac64: `movs r0,#1; bl 0x556602` then `movs r0,#1; bl 0x5565e0`; 0x556602 builds a zero message and calls the audio-thread poster 0x5561b0 (queue 0x200046f8) with subtype 1 (the GX8002 configuration step). Sibling 0x556624 posts subtype 4. ABI (uint32 subtype) inferred from both stock callers. Gated behind MIC_FLAG_ARM_HW; posted from the settings-write context like the other codec messages.

0x592db5.derivation: 2.2.10.41 FW_CODEC_PWR_OFF: gx8002 power OFF (drv_gx8002b.c; logs 'gx8002 power off.' / 'gx8002 already power off.'; guards on power flag 0x200773d6; the first step of the codec reboot handler 0x595c12 and a direct call from the UART test dispatcher 0x59c200). 2.2.10.10 0x5959b8 (Thumb +1); 2.2.9.22 0x592db4 located by prologue byte-match with the codec-driver functions in identical relative order/spacing in both images (power on / power off / i2s init deltas 0xb4 and 0xa0). ABI (void, no args) from both stock callers. Called from the CFW settle timer (RTOS timer thread), which stock itself does from its non-audio UART test dispatcher.

0x592d01.derivation: 2.2.10.41 FW_CODEC_PWR_ON: gx8002 power ON (drv_gx8002b.c; logs 'gx8002 power on.' / 'gx8002 already power on.'; guards on 0x200773d6; the step after the 100 ms delay in the reboot handler 0x595c12 and a direct call from 0x59c200). 2.2.10.10 0x595904 (Thumb +1); 2.2.9.22 0x592d00 located by prologue byte-match with the codec-driver functions in identical relative order/spacing in both images (power on / power off / i2s init deltas 0xb4 and 0xa0). ABI (void, no args) from both stock callers. Called from the CFW settle timer (RTOS timer thread), which stock itself does from its non-audio UART test dispatcher.

0x51d815.derivation: 2.2.10.42 FW_PIN_WRITE: the board's logical-pin writer dispatcher (2.2.10.10 0x5200b8, Thumb +1; 2.2.9.22 0x51d814 by 28-byte prologue match, and the old function carries the same 0x8f/0x92 codec GPIO constants and the 0x86 rail GPIO). ABI (uint32 logical_pin, uint32 value) from the codec driver's callers (`movs r1,#val; movs r0,#pin; bl`). Logical pins 7 and 8 are plain GPIO writes to Apollo GPIO 143 and 146 (the GX8002 enable/reset lines, handlers 0x520198/0x5201ae → 0x554102); logical pin 6 is NOT a GPIO — it sets/clears bit 6 of the rail-request mask 0x200765fc inside a critical section and drives Apollo GPIO 134, a shared regulator enable, low when the mask is zero. The codec driver's power-off (0x5959b8) clears pin 6 and drops that rail, which the EM9305 radio path depends on: the phone logs 'connection timed out' 772 ms after CONFIGURE (720 ms supervision). The CFW therefore resets the codec through pins 7 and 8 ONLY and never writes pin 6. Called from the CFW settle timer (RTOS timer thread); the stock UART test dispatcher 0x59c200 reaches the same driver from a non-audio thread.

0x5681a9.derivation: 2.2.10.46 FW_AUDM_ACQUIRE: service_audio_manager acquire (LEFT-only; bails unless _private_getCurrentRoleStatus==2). Registers app_id in the slot table 0x200763b8, and on the first active client resets shared audio state and enables PDM + the GX8002 codec + DMA (openCFW g2-service-audio-manager-recovery.md: 'first acquire resets shared audio state and enables PDM + codec'). 2.2.10.10 0x56ac64 (Thumb +1); 2.2.9.22 0x5681a8 by prologue match + helper delta 0x2abc (its slot-count helper 0x56ac48 matches old 0x56818c) + the app_id<8 and slot==1 checks. ABI (uint8 app_id) from the disassembly and the at_codec.c caller (openCFW). oldBytes/newBytes cover the side-check prologue; the differing BL to the side getter is expected across versions.

0x568337.derivation: 2.2.10.46 FW_AUDM_RELEASE: service_audio_manager release (LEFT-only); clears app_id from the slot table and, when every slot is 0, disables the codec + PDM. 2.2.10.10 0x56adf2; 2.2.9.22 0x568336 by the same prologue+delta reasoning as the acquire. ABI (uint8 app_id).

0x4db279.derivation: 2.2.10.50 FW_DM_SET_PHY: Cordio DmSetPhy(connId, allPhys, txPhys, rxPhys, phyOptions) (2.2.10.10 0x4ddb04, Thumb +1; 2.2.9.22 at the key address). Identified 2026-09-15 in both images by the same chain: the unique `movw #0x2032` (HCI LE Set PHY opcode) marks HciLeSetPhyCmd; its single BL caller is DmSetPhy, which resolves the DM connection via the conn-table lookup and passes phyOptions from its stack slot. Single stock caller is the ring-link '[ring.proto]RING_SetPhyProcess' wrapper (0x479426 new); the phone link never receives a PHY request from stock.

0x20076594.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key). Identified 2026-09-15 by disassembly of the connection-parameter request path: _connectParamReq_impl (0x47c0e8) calls the getter 0x475814 which returns *(0x20076594), the phone-connection object, and reads its DM connId byte at +4 for the DmConnUpdate request. mic_control reads the same object/+4 to address DmSetPhy at the phone link; validated as a 0x20xxxxxx pointer and connId 1..4 before use.

0x56873b.derivation: 2.2.10.51 FW_AUDM_PEER_MSG_ORIG: stock common-data handler for inter-temple frame 0x010C (2.2.10.10 0x56b1f6, Thumb +1; 2.2.9.22 0x56873a, identical 16-byte body). Identified 2026-09-15 from the rodata dispatch table entry {u32 0x010C, handler, 0} at 0x6c12a0 (new) / 0x6be5b0 (old): validates (data,len), logs, then feeds data[0] to the audio-manager peer-message processor 0x556928 and returns 0. mic_peer_sync_hook tail-calls it for every frame it does not swallow.

0x46aac9.derivation: 2.2.10.62 FW_PEER_SEND: inter-temple common-data send (2.2.10.10 0x46b0ac, Thumb +1; 2.2.9.22 0x46aac8, identical 16-byte body). Identified 2026-09-15 by mapping the audio manager's AUDM_SendSyncMsgToPeer body from the openCFW 2.2.6.10 image (0x54F694) into both images (2.2.10.10 0x56af78, 2.2.9.22 0x5684bc): that sender's only transport call is `mov.w r0,#0x10c; add r1,sp,#0xc; movs r2,#1; movs r3,#0; bl` here, i.e. send(record_id, buf, len, opt=0). openCFW names the 2.2.6.10 twin 0x4651E0 'G2 common-data peer transport'.

0x593139.derivation: 2.2.10.62 FW_LC3_ENCODE_MONO: stock SVC_Lc3EncodeMono (2.2.10.10 0x595d3c, Thumb +1; 2.2.9.22 0x593138, matched by BL-masked 48-byte body). Identified 2026-09-15 from the pool references to the '[svc.audio]lc3_encode failed at frame %d, ret=%d' and 'SVC_Lc3EncodeMono' strings; ABI per openCFW g2-liblc3-service-audio-route.md: int encode(const void *pcm, uint32_t bytes, void *out, int32_t *written, void *ctx) with the 0x1c-byte context header {fmt, dt_us, sr_hz, nch, ch, bitrate, enc} and inline encoder storage; the encoder is created lazily via lc3_setup_encoder (0x5ad5a4) when ctx->enc == 0.

0x5d60eb.derivation: 2.2.10.69 FW_INFLATE_RESET: zlib 1.1.4 inflateReset (2.2.10.10 0x5d8dda, Thumb +1; 2.2.9.22 0x5d60ea). Identified 2026-09-15: the function immediately preceding the already-reviewed inflateEnd (0x5d612b -> 0x5d8e1b, same +0x2cf0 delta) with the exact zlib body: z/z->state NULL check returns Z_STREAM_ERROR(-2), total_in=total_out=0, msg=NULL, state->mode = state->nowrap ? BLOCKS(7) : METHOD(0), then inflate_blocks_reset(state->blocks, z, NULL). Byte-identical in both images.

0x442389.derivation: 2.2.10.69 FW_SEM_TAKE: FreeRTOS xQueueSemaphoreTake(handle, ticks) (same address in 2.2.9.22 and 2.2.10.10; kernel text is unchanged between the two). Identified 2026-09-15 as the single BL target inside the stock display-gate wrapper FUN_00479482 (already reviewed as 0x479483 -> 0x47a717) after it loads the semaphore handle and 1000 ticks; the wrapper returns pdTRUE/pdFALSE from this call only to discard it (pop {r0,pc}), which is why the CFW calls it directly. Body: NULL/invalid-queue configASSERT stubs, then the standard semaphore take loop.

0x5410ef.derivation: 2.2.10.69 FW_HCI_LE_SET_DATA_LEN: Cordio HciLeSetDataLen(handle, txOctets, txTime) (2.2.10.10 0x543996, Thumb +1; 2.2.9.22 0x5410ee). Identified 2026-09-15 in both images by the unique `movw r0,#0x2022` (HCI LE Set Data Length opcode) with length 6 into hciCmdAlloc (the same allocator HciLeSetPhyCmd/0x2032 uses, reviewed via FW_DM_SET_PHY), followed by three little-endian u16 stores (handle, txOctets, txTime) and hciCmdSend. Bodies identical modulo BL displacement.

0x4ca71f.derivation: 2.2.10.69 FW_DM_CONN_CCB: Cordio dmConnCcbById(connId) -> dmConnCcb_t* or NULL (2.2.10.10 0x4cca82, Thumb +1; 2.2.9.22 0x4ca71e). Identified 2026-09-15 as the lookup DmSetPhy (reviewed 0x4db279 -> 0x4ddb05) calls between its WSF lock/unlock: table base literal, 0x30-byte entries indexed by connId-1, valid flag at +0x16, NULL when unused; DmSetPhy then reads the HCI handle u16 at +0xc, which mic_request_dle reuses. Byte-identical in both images except the table literal.

0x200769e4.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address as key): the stock display-gate semaphore handle. Identified 2026-09-15 as the literal loaded by the reviewed display-gate take/give wrappers (2.2.10.10 0x47a716 `ldr r2,[pc,#0xe8]` -> literal 0x47a804; 2.2.9.22 0x479482 loads 0x2007698c the same way). Both wrappers test the cell for NULL, take/give it through the FreeRTOS semaphore entries, and log on failure; the CFW takes it directly so the take result is observable.

0x20004780.derivation: 2.2.10.10 RAM cell (same address in 2.2.9.22): the stock ble_msgtx control block; the FreeRTOS handle of the 150-entry msgtx queue is at +0xc. Identified 2026-09-15 as the literal the msgtx enqueue (2.2.10.10 0x47e5de, 2.2.9.22 0x47d342 — the six-argument function every reviewed notify entry calls, openCFW open_cfw_ble_msgtx_enqueue) loads before testing the handle for NULL and posting with xQueueGenericSend 0x443298. The CFW reads the queue depth (Queue_t.uxMessagesWaiting at handle+0x38, uxLength at +0x3c; layout confirmed by the semaphore take checking uxItemSize at +0x40) to back-pressure relay notifies below the enqueue's silent half-capacity drop.

hooks.note: 2.2.10.22+: min = max = 15 ms (the exact form Apple accepts; a 15-30 range left the Mac's 30 ms default in force). 2.2.10.21: 0c001800; 2.2.10.19/20: 09000c00; <= 2.2.10.18: 06000600.
